status: draft: tone not yet validated against hand labels; thresholds are first choices

received_per_year.label: Challenges received as a backbencher per year (log)

cross_bloc_share.label: Share of own challenges aimed at the other bloc

own_party_share.label: Share of own challenges aimed at own party

at_government_share.label: Share of own challenges aimed at the government

tone.label: Mean tone of own challenges (AFINN per 100 words)

negative_share.label: Share of own challenges with negative tone

emotional.label: Emotional words per 100 words (positive or negative)

connective_rate.label: Argument words per 100 words (men, fordi, derfor, jo ...)

tone_at_other_bloc.label: Mean tone of own challenges aimed at the other bloc

rebel_rate.label: Votes against own party (2017 on; 0 before)

attack_dog.name: Attack dog
attack_dog.rule: Top 10% for challenges made per year, with most of them aimed at the other bloc or the government.

lightning_rod.name: Lightning rod
lightning_rod.rule: Top 10% for challenges received per year while not a minister.

negative_nancy.name: Negative Nancy
negative_nancy.rule: Bottom 10% for mean tone of own challenges.

bridge_builder.name: Bridge builder
bridge_builder.rule: Top 10% for the tone of challenges aimed at the other bloc, among members with at least 20 such challenges.

defector.name: Defector
defector.rule: Changed party at least once between sessions (leaving for no group counts).

rebel.name: Rebel
rebel.rule: Top 10% for votes against own party, among members with at least 300 cast votes from 2017 on.
